audience_question: Which retrofit barrier is most common overall, and did service turnaround improve?
fit_rationale: The two parts of the question require separate evidence: partner-specific barrier figures and turnaround measures. An asymmetric two-panel slide makes the limits explicit without suggesting compatible comparison, while naming the information needed to answer both parts.
tradeoff: Separating partner evidence avoids a misleading overall ranking, but means the slide cannot name a single most-common barrier.
caveats: North allowed overlapping selections among 40 survey respondents.
South reviewed 15 cases but did not report the total homeowners served; other barriers may co-occur.
South turnaround median is 8 days for 11 cases; four of 15 reviewed cases had no time recorded.
The unmethoded “around two weeks last spring” note is not comparable to the recent partial median.
Partners lack a shared period definition, common denominator, and comparable baseline.
